title: Disponibilidad del parqueadero (página principal)
purpose: Let any student, teacher or director see at a glance how many free parking spaces there are in each zone before leaving home.

sections.name: Hero / header
sections.description: Navy-to-dark-blue gradient band with the H1 'Disponibilidad del parqueadero' in white, subtitle 'Consulta los cupos libres antes de llegar a la universidad', and on the right a small chip with a pulsing green dot 'Actualizado hace 12 segundos'.

sections.name: Big total KPI
sections.description: A large white floating card overlapping the hero: huge number '30' in navy, label 'cupos libres en total', secondary text 'de 130 cupos en 4 zonas', and a gold button with a download icon 'Descargar PDF de ocupación'.

sections.name: Zone cards grid
sections.description: Four equal cards in a 4-column row (2x2 on narrow). Each card: zone name, vehicle icon (car or motorcycle), huge free-spaces number, text 'cupos libres', horizontal occupancy progress bar with percentage, small line 'X de Y ocupados', and a status pill. Data: (1) 'Zona A - Carros', car icon, 18 libres, 22 de 40 ocupados, bar 55% green, pill 'DISPONIBLE'. (2) 'Zona B - Carros', car icon, 11 libres, 19 de 30 ocupados, bar 63% green, pill 'DISPONIBLE'. (3) 'Zona Directivas', car icon, 1 libre, 9 de 10 ocupados, bar 90% amber, pill 'POCOS CUPOS'. (4) 'Zona Motos', motorcycle icon, 0 libres, 50 de 50 ocupados, bar 100% red, pill 'LLENA'. Card top border or accent matches the status color.

sections.name: Legend row
sections.description: Small legend below the cards with three colored dots: 'Disponible', 'Pocos cupos (10% o menos)', 'Llena'.

state_to_depict: Normal daytime state with a mix of green, amber and red cards.
